column1: # Which voices may be used for which language, and why.
# A voice is only usable for a language if it is a native voice for that
# language. The multilingual novelty voices synthesise Mandarin badly enough
# that every recogniser fails on the audio itself, so they cannot measure an ASR
# engine at all: whisper small scores 46-69% zh CER on those clips while scoring
# 3.4% WER on the English clips from the same eight voices. Their English is
# native, so they remain valid for English.
#   Tingting   yes -   Mandarin voice; no English variant, accented English
#   Sinji      no  -   Cantonese voice reading Mandarin; 65.7% zh CER because
#                      the audio itself is accented, so it measures the voice
#   Sandy      -   yes multilingual novelty voice, Mandarin damaged
# Excluding a clip does not mean dropping it from the sweep: it means not
# scoring it. A voice that is wrong for the language produces a number that
# looks like an engine defect and is not one, which is exactly how the first
